rows.name: Banker
rows.why: Banker (4: "Now and at round start, +3 gold"). By arithmetic +9/+6/+3 gold by round recruited, ~7 averaged, plus a follower; the Normal sweep read 7.3 [6.3–8.3] recruited in round I.

rows.name: Big Family
rows.why: Big Family (4: "Worth 3 followers", no ability), the plain worth-N member: 3 followers ≈ 4 resources at 4→3, less the follower buy it displaces. The Normal sweep read 2.4 [0.6–3.6].

rows.name: Sponsor
rows.why: Sponsor (10: "Your members cost 2 less"), rework-candidates #1, known strong: must not read cheaper than printed − 2.

rows.name: Tycoon
rows.why: Tycoon (12: "Game end: +1 follower per 3 gold"), rework-candidates #3, known weak: must read at least 2 under printed.
